title: Nifty 50 slips further below 200-DMA, raising fears of a bearish turn
summary: The Nifty 50's drop below its 200-day moving average to 5.75% suggests a bearish trend, with significant selling pressure. Contributing factors include rising US bond yields and crude oil prices, along with increasing concerns about inflation in India.
